_doc: Pictures for the website's guide cards (meridian-shards-website /guides, its scripts/optimise-images.mjs), in the format of backgrounds.json: the 3D view alone, no interface. Take them with `npm run shots -- --manifest guides.json --client modern`.

shots.title: Frular in the Guildmaster's Hall
shots.note: Frular stands behind his counter at 5,7 facing south (barlqrm/gmhall.kod); from 9,7 facing north and looking up, the counter's canopy and pillars round him and the crown banner behind.
